posts.search: How Do You Simplify Onboarding for a Complex Professional Tool Without Sacrificing Its Power? Day 12 of 1,000 Product Manager Interview Questions 1000 Product Manager Interview Questions Product Design & UX Product Onboarding Progressive Disclosure Professional Software User Activation Contextual Help What Is the Interview Question Really Testing? First, Understand Where the Complexity Comes From What Should We Clarify Before Proposing a Solution? Novice and Expert Users Are Not Necessarily Fixed Groups Three Approaches to Simplifying the Experience Approach One: Remove or Extensively Hide Features Approach Two: Explain the Entire Product During Onboarding Approach Three: Task-Based Onboarding and Progressive Disclosure What Should an Effective Onboarding Experience Include? 1. Help Users Achieve Their First Meaningful Outcome 2. Provide Guidance When It Is Needed 3. Preserve Fast Paths for Experienced Users
